name: K9 Wireless Lavalier Microphone | Plug & Play Type-C & iOS Mic with Noise Reduction
description:
Upgrade your recordings with the K9 Wireless Lavalier Microphone, designed for USB Type-C and iOS devices. Delivering professional-quality sound, it features advanced noise reduction and auto-sync technology for seamless video and audio alignment. With its portable, lightweight design and true plug-and-play setup, this microphone is perfect for vloggers, teachers, musicians, interviewers, and live streamers. No apps or drivers required—just connect and start recording with crystal-clear audio.
Key Features
 Wide compatibility with USB Type-C and iOS devices
 Built-in noise reduction for clear professional sound
 Real-time auto-sync technology for perfect audio-video match
 Plug-and-play design with no extra setup
 Portable and lightweight for creators on the go
 Ideal for streaming, teaching, podcasts, and music recording
Ingredients / Materials
High-quality ABS plastic, electronic components, metal clip
How to Use
 Plug the receiver into Type-C or Lightning port
 Clip the microphone to your clothing
 Power on the mic and it auto-connects instantly
 Start recording or streaming with clear sound
Package Includes
 1 × K9 Wireless Lavalier Microphone
 1 × Receiver (Type-C or iOS)
 1 × Charging Cable
